business_summary: Kokuyo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, purchases, and sells office furniture products in Japan and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Furniture Business, Business Supply Distribution Business, Stationery Business, and Interior Retail Business. It offers office and public furniture, office supplies, stationery, and rear and household goods. The company also engages in wholesale, delivery, and assembly of interior and furniture; notebooks, writing instruments, and art supplies, with the Campus brand; procures and sells interior and lifestyle goods, operating instores and e-commerce stores; work style consulting; proposal and support system for stationery and office supplies; development and sale of creative picture book series and tools for creativity; and document digitization services, as well as spatial design and construction for offices, medical and educational institutions, public offices, and agencies. In addition, it is involved in the transportation and storage of products; sale of paper products; provision of outsourcing services for general affairs and other administrative tasks; furniture and building materials installation; procurement and leasing of office equipment; mail order sales of office supplies; and non-life insurance agency business. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Kokkodo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kokuyo Co., Ltd. in January 1961. Kokuyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.
